messages:
Jules Carter: Heads-up: Greenline Health needs an EU-local POC. Requirements: tenant pin to eu-north-1, BYO KMS, signed sub-processor list, VPC peering. Can we triage owners?
Hannah Meyer: I can take pricing + AE deck. Do they insist on Dedicated? They said 'no cross-border processing' in the security questionnaire.
Omar Khalid: infra note: we can do Dedicated in eu-north-1 or hosted with a hard tenant_pin and disabled failover for the POC window. Need explicit routing policy and ops attestation.
Priya Nair: Legal asks for a signed subproc PDF that enumerates which vendors will touch PII during POC, plus cert links. Also need clear BYO KMS flow (do we ever touch plaintext DEKs?).
Omar Khalid: Envelope encryption only. We store encrypted DEKs; no plaintext keys in our control plane. Can include a short attestation.
Jules Carter: Customer wants timeline: 7 business days start-to-demo. Any major blockers?
Hannah Meyer: Pricing ballpark: Dedicated demo slab ~= ,800/week; hosted hard-pin trial ~= ,200 + KMS ops ~00. I'll refine and send a 1-slide comparison.
Priya Nair: Runbook owner? Need VPC peering steps, cert exchange, KMS ARN verification, and test matrix (locality + KMS roundtrip + p95 latency).
Omar Khalid: I'll open ops ticket and draft runbook. Minimal config snippet we can show the customer: 
```
routing_policy: tenant_pin
allowed_regions: ["eu-north-1"]
failover: "none_unless_approved"
telemetry: "eu-only"
```
Jules Carter: Ops ticket created?
ops-bot: Ticket RDW-1333 created: "Greenline EU-north POC: VPC peering, BYO KMS, subproc attestation" assigned to @omar.k
Priya Nair: Legal: please draft POC addendum prohibiting cross-border routing for the POC period and requiring notification + pause right if a routing change is proposed.
legal-bot: Will prepare draft addendum and DPA checklist; will need the signed subproc PDF.
Hannah Meyer: ETA pricing numbers 6 hours.
Omar Khalid: ETA runbook + subproc export 20 hours.
Jules Carter: Action items: Hannah pricing, Omar runbook & ops ticket, Priya legal addendum. Aim for first drafts by Tue 09:00 UTC. Keep thread for audit. :thumbsup:
